study type: Experimental laboratory study with case-control comparison
outcome: eNOS (endothelial NO synthase) expression in endothelial cells
cohort: The study included placentas from 8 women with early-onset preeclampsia and 6 controls, as well as their maternal plasma, and used monocyte, macrophage, and endothelial cells in culture.
finding: Increased release of syncytiotrophoblast-derived vesicle-bound 5'-tRF-Glu-CTC contributes to preeclampsia pathophysiology by inducing inflammation in macrophages and reducing eNOS expression in endothelial cells.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy at the time of early-onset preeclampsia diagnosis for placenta and maternal plasma samples.
